_comment: Optional manual overrides for athlete data. Merged at load time by AthletesRepository, keyed by the athlete `id` (now `ifsc-<numericIfscId>`, e.g. `ifsc-1480`). Use this for: better/recent photos, corrected last_competed years, a youtube_channel_id (UC… 24-char), x_handle (e.g. "jakob_schubert"), or other small fixes. The scraper always overwrites the base ifsc_athletes.json from the IFSC API; put human-curated values here so they survive re-scrapes.
